name: slider
description: An input where the user selects a value, or range of values, by dragging a handle within a track. Use for numeric ranges like volume or price, built on Radix Slider.

keyboard.action: Move the focused thumb by the supported increment.

aria: Each thumb exposes slider value/min/max semantics and supports range sliders.
consumer: Provide a contextual aria-label or aria-labelledby for every thumb.
